Key friction points to document:
1. **widget.List has no per-row styling or rendering hook** — entries are Buttons created from a single EntryLabelFunc; EntryColor is global per selection-state; no access to entry buttons (private `buttons`/`listContent`); no BBCode on entries (TextProcessBBCode never enabled by List). This forced: hostile/player tints as a post-draw overlay; virtualized windowing for exact geometry.
2. **List scroll state is private** — `scrollContainer.ScrollTop` unreachable; `setScrollTop` unexported. Combined with #1 (no per-row geometry), native internal scrolling makes row positions unknowable → the spec's "native scroll" + "per-row tint" requirements are mutually exclusive. Workaround: HideVerticalSlider (which ALSO removes the internal wheel handler — a hidden coupling discoverable only by reading source), wheel via the list widget's exported ScrolledEvent, entries paged to fit.
3. **List.SetEntries silently nils the selection** (no event) and O(n²) dedups; selection must be re-applied by the app.
4. **No double-click event anywhere** (Button has Pressed/Released/Clicked only) → AllowReselect + timing heuristic; also Window ResizeEvent fires on ANY press-release over contents (not actual edge drags) — surprising but harmless.
5. **Resize handle = invisible 6px edge strips**; resize initiation listens on the Contents widget press (so you CAN start by pressing a row and dragging to the edge — subtle); cursor shapes only via ebitenui's cursor management.
6. **Width pinning needs BOTH WidgetOpts.MinSize AND RowLayoutData.MaxWidth** — Min alone can't shrink below preferred; neither alone is sufficient.
7. **Event handlers and AddHandler are deferred** to the next ui.Update (event.ExecuteDeferred) — handlers registered in constructors don't fire until first Update; easy to misread as "not registered".
8. **Theme propagation is parent-chain only** — PrimaryTheme must be set before AddWindow or windows validate themeless; widgets Validate eagerly at AddWindow and panic on missing Image/Face if theme absent. Also list entry buttons validate BEFORE parenting (they only survive because createEntry passes explicit face/color/image).
9. **text/v2 interop**: painless — *text.GoTextFace satisfies text.Face; ebitenui wants *text.Face (pointer-to-interface) — facePtr helper is one line; text.Measure used directly for column math; measure cache inside Text keys by label so live labels re-measure only on change. Zero friction beyond the pointer-to-interface oddity.
10. **ebiten.ErrQuit no longer exists → ebiten.Termination** (renamed by v2.10) — my first build failed on it; examples/docs memory outdated.
11. **Preferred height contains a page-independent constant** (slider chrome): pref/n overestimates row height (32.67 vs true 30) — caught by diagnostics; two-sample measurement fixes. Hidden coupling: hidden horizontal slider also changes pref.
12. **Examples lied by omission**: no table/column example exists anywhere in _examples; list demo is single-column strings; theming demo never applies theme to windows; no per-row color capability is documented. The demos are correct about what they show but give no path to the two hardest problems (columns, per-row styling).

14. **Rows are a single string** — columns must be space-padded text composed via measuring; works (sub-pixel-ish alignment, ≤ space-width drift per column) but is fundamentally a hack; upstream needs a real table widget or per-entry render hook.

## 1. Kill-criteria assessment

**(a) Theme reproduces the EVE-dark look — YES.** Verified three ways: `TestThemeMatchesLegacyPalette` pins all 18 palette colors and the type scale to `ui`'s; the captured live frame (`/tmp/opencode/frame.png`) shows dark translucent panels, amber titles/accents, the `#131926` header strip, thin borders, dimmed disabled buttons, right-aligned numerics, the teal player-row tint, and the ▲ sort arrow rendering (goregular *does* contain U+25B2 — `ui/style.go`'s "no reliable glyph" comment is outdated; vector triangles unneeded). Deviations: no layered drop shadow, no zebra stripes.

**(b) Resize + elastic columns — YES (logic).** `FitColumns` (surplus→Name, shrink order Velocity→Kind→Distance→Name-to-floor, exact-sum fit) and `Ellipsize` are table-tested; min-size clamp (320×240) and refit-on-resize are asserted with an exact column-sum check (890 px at a 900 px window) plus cumulative-rounding header pinning. The actual drag interaction (invisible 6 px edge strips) needs the desktop run.

**(c) text/v2 interop — painless.** `render.Face(size)` satisfies `text.Face` directly; ebitenui's `*text.Face` (pointer-to-interface) needed exactly the one-line `facePtr` helper as the brief predicted. `text.Measure` powers all column math; ebitenui's internal `Text.measure` caches by label, so live distance labels re-measure only when changed. Zero friction beyond the odd `*text.Face` convention.

**(d) Input handling surprises — several:** (1) every `Event.Fire`/`AddHandler` is **deferred** to the next `ui.Update` — handlers registered in constructors are dead until the first Update (bit my test ordering); (2) a window's `ResizeEvent` fires on **any** press-release over its contents, not only real edge drags; (3) ebitenui's `BlockLower` input layers gate only ebitenui widgets — raw ebiten input under windows still reaches the game (spike unaffected; production must self-gate via `input.UIHovered` or window rects); (4) wheel events fire on **every** widget in the parent chain — attach exactly one handler (I used the list widget's exported `ScrolledEvent`); (5) list arrow-key focus calls an internal scroll-into-view that would fight any externally-informed scroll state if content overflowed (structurally avoided: content always fits); (6) `ebiten.ErrQuit` no longer exists in v2.10 — it's `ebiten.Termination`.

**(e) Draw performance notes.** Per-frame cost is bounded by the visible page (~16 rows at default size): labels rebuild only when text changes via `List.UpdateEntry` (which recreates one button + `ReplaceChild` + relayout — the cheapest API available, not cheap per se), full column re-measure only on resize/sort/rowset-change + every 90 frames. No allocation benchmarking was done; before production, benchmark `UpdateEntry` churn at 500+ visible rows and note `List.SetEntries` is O(n²) (duplicate check) — at scale you'd diff incrementally instead.

## 2. Exact ebitenui API friction (this decides adoption)

1. **`widget.List` cannot render columns.** An entry is one string from `EntryLabelFunc`, drawn as one Button label; there is no table widget and no per-entry render hook anywhere in the library. Columns exist only as space-padded text composed by measuring prefixes (works, ≤ one space-width drift per column, but it's a hack).
2. **No per-row styling whatsoever.** `ListEntryColor` is global-per-selection-state; entry buttons are private; `setEntryButtonStyle` clobbers any per-button override on every selection change; `EntryLabelFunc` can't return BBCode (List never enables `TextProcessBBCode`). Hostile/player tints had to become a post-draw overlay — which is only sound because rows have exact geometry (next point).
3. **Scroll state is private.** `ScrollContainer.ScrollTop` is an exported *field* you can't reach (the list's instance is unexported), `setScrollTop` unexported, entry rects unreachable (`List` isn't a `Locater`, unlike containers). So per-row tinting and native internal scrolling are **mutually exclusive**: I hid the vertical slider (which — only visible in source — also removes the internal wheel handler), wheel-paged entries through the exported `ScrolledEvent`, and kept content always fitting. The brief's "native scroll" and "tinted rows" requirements cannot both be met upstream; this needs either a scroll getter or a real table widget.
4. **`SetEntries` silently nils the selection** (no event) and is O(n²); selection must be re-applied by the app — I distinguish app re-application from user clicks via `PreviousEntry == nil`.
5. **No double-click event exists** (Button: Pressed/Released/Clicked only) → `AllowReselect` + a 350 ms timing window; programmatic re-selection is detectable via `PreviousEntry == nil`.
6. **Exact widths need both `WidgetOpts.MinSize` and `RowLayoutData.MaxWidth`** — Min can raise but never shrink a header button below its text; Max alone never raises. Nothing documents this pairing.
7. **Theme propagation is parent-chain-only and validation is eager**: set `PrimaryTheme` before `AddWindow`, or windows validate themeless and `Button.Validate` panics (`Image required`). List entry buttons actually validate *before* parenting — safe only because `createEntry` passes explicit image/face/colors.
8. **Examples lied by omission**: the list demo is single-column strings, the theming demo never applies a theme to a window, and no example shows columns, per-row color, scroll introspection, or double-click — the four things this migration needed most.

## 3. Files, tests, demo

Files: `uikit/theme.go` (Palette/TypeScale/`NewTheme`, all 13 theme entries, generated nine-slices), `uikit/kit.go` (package doc: "intended successor to ui/"; `Kit`, `NewKit`, `Update`, `Draw`, `Sync`, `Selected`), `uikit/overview.go` (`FitColumns`, `Ellipsize`, `Row`, stable sort, compose, tints, wheel paging, resize refit, formatters), `uikit/selected.go` (Selected Item window: Approach / Warp to 10 km / Stop), plus the three test files listed above, and `cmd/enui-spike/main.go`.

Tests (10): `TestThemeMatchesLegacyPalette`, `TestFormattersMatchLegacy`, `TestFitColumns`, `TestEllipsize`, `TestNewKitConstruction`, `TestSortRows`, `TestRowActivationSelectsThenApproaches`, `TestSelectedButtonsEnqueueCommands`, `TestOverviewMinSizeAndRefit`, `TestDrawSmoke` (both 1280×720 and 1024×700, in-bounds windows, page-fits-window invariant, selection-survives-rebuild).

Run: `go test ./uikit/... -count=1` · full suite `go test ./... -count=1` (385 pass) · demo `go run ./cmd/enui-spike`.

## 4. Recommendation

**Adopt-with-changes.** text/v2 interop, the theme system, windows and the event/handler model all worked as advertised, the EVE-dark look reproduces exactly (verified by pixel capture), and the command seam stayed clean — but ebitenui has no table widget, no per-row styling, and no scroll introspection, which forced two structural workarounds (single-string space-padded columns and page-virtualized rows) that a production overview will eventually outgrow; adopt uikit as the UI layer now, keep `FitColumns`/`Ellipsize`/theme/parity tests as the foundation, and upstream-or-vendor one of the two small changes — either a `List` scroll getter + per-entry color hook (~50 lines against ebitenui) or a dedicated column-list widget — before building the station/market/fitting screens on top.
